messages:
maya: FYI planning to roll 2026.04.2 tomorrow 10:30 PST. Primary change: adaptive batcher + small-kernel tweak for short-turn chat. Drafting internal note + ops checklist now. Need quick pin/rollback guidance. @thomas @renee?

thomas: Quick scan good. Primary concern: adaptive batcher edge-case under bursty QPS. Suggest pin runtime to runtime:v2.5.0 for the first 48h and keep the canary conservative.

renee: agree on pin to runtime:v2.5.0. Canary plan: 3% for 10m -> 15% for 20m -> 40% for 30m -> 100%. Gate conditions: if during any canary stage token P95 > 700ms OR 5xx > 0.4% sustained for 5m -> abort. Also abort on KV cache mismatch or model shard errors reported by deploybot.

maya: Good. Can someone write a short embargoed blurb for internal channel (one para + TL;DR for oncall)? Need it by 10:10 PST to schedule embargoed post.

liam: Draft snippet below (feel free to copy):
"""
Internal (embargo until 10:20 PST): Release 2026.04.2 rolling 10:30 PST. This release improves batching efficiency for short-context workloads and includes a small serving kernel optimization. We will canary progressively (3% -> 15% -> 40% -> 100%) with runtime pinned to v2.5.0 for 48h. Oncall: thomas (primary), renee (secondary). Immediate abort if P95 token latency >700ms or 5xx >0.4% for 5m. If you see KV cache or shard errors, escalate to @infra.
"""
Mark embargo until 10:20 PST.

deploybot: Scheduled: `/deploy release/2026.04.2 --canary 3,15,40 --staging true --pin runtime:v2.5.0 --notify #eng-releases` (embargo-until=1777779600)

oncall-bot: oncall rotation set: thomas (primary) renee (secondary). Pager thresholds: token-p95=700ms, 5xx=0.4%

maya: Thanks. Adding rollback decision tree to release doc:
- Abort & immediate rollback if:
  - 5xx > 0.4% sustained for 5m OR
  - token P95 > 700ms for 3 consecutive 5m windows OR
  - deploybot reports model shard mismatch / KV cache fail
- Stepwise mitigation (no immediate abort):
  - small error bump (<0.1% over baseline) -> scale GPU pools, temporarily raise batch cap, monitor 15m
- Post-success: keep runtime pinned 48h, then remove pin if stable for 24h; run regression eval set and roll forward pin removal in maintenance window.

thomas: I'll be watching dashboards and will post a quick canary summary in this thread at each gate. renee will handle escalation if infra needs to intervene.

renee: :thumbsup: i'll standby. If we abort, prefer to rollback to previous runtime image runtime:v2.4.8 and hold full traffic until we validate.

maya: all set. I'll paste liam's blurb into the internal announce at 10:10 PST (embargo) and then trigger deploybot at 10:30. Final checklist saved to release doc: 1) embargoed blurb posted at 10:10, 2) deploybot scheduled, 3) canary gate checks + thresholds, 4) rollback contacts, 5) post-release evals. Pinning doc in #eng-releases after posting.

liam: :rocket: Good luck, folks — will ping if I spot anything odd during the canary.
